title: watchtowr-itw: watchTowr's own pages are now captured and carry the claim; the note still says watchtowr.com returns 403
description: The vault re-captured watchtowr-php2shell (20261023T232528Z) and watchtowr-php2shell-faq (20261023T160435Z) with content: 'EXPLOITED IN THE WILD: Yes, reported by watchTowr' and 'watchTowr has observed exploitation in the wild through its Attacker Eye honeypot network'. Say also what it rests on: honeypot observations, like Amazon's.
